item.title: Centro Ovale Chiasso: new ownership and end of Ellipticum
item.description: After the failure of the Ellipticum project on 9 settembre, the Centro Ovale di Chiasso passes to a fashion multinational, destination still uncertain.
item.content:encoded:
For the cross-border worker entering Chiasso after customs, the news has a precise scope: it describes the ownership and still-uncertain future of a building, not an announced change to work or border crossing. The source does not indicate an opening date, an already authorized activity, new hires, services for those passing through or changes to traffic. It is therefore not possible to turn the multinational’s possible presence into a job announcement, nor to interpret the change of ownership as a change for those who cross the area daily.
The available geographical reference is the entrance to Chiasso after customs. The text does not name the Brogeda border crossing and does not provide schedules, waiting times or alternative routes. Those using the area can consult mappa valichi for guidance, but the source does not link Centro Ovale to traffic changes.
| Element | What is known | |---|---| | Ownership | According to information from RSI, ownership has been transferred to a fashion multinational. | | Destination | The possibilities of production, retail outlet or something else remain open. | | Ellipticum | The project reached its end after the failure of the promoting company. | | Procedure | The appeal against the bankruptcy obtained suspensive effect; the decision is awaited. | | Mobility | Only the location at the entrance, after customs, is indicated. |
The three destinations do not have the same practical meaning, but the source does not allow a choice among them. A production site, a retail outlet or another destination are merely the hypotheses mentioned; none has been presented as a decision. Therefore, it is not possible to speak of opening hours, access, jobs or available services. The useful information for those crossing Chiasso is precisely the absence of an announced operational change.
For the cross-border worker, the text does not deal with a G permit, AVS, LPP or LAMal; it does not indicate tax rebates, withholding tax, INPS, double taxation or the new 2026 tax agreement. The matter remains local: it concerns Chiasso and Canton Ticino, but does not link the change of ownership to these matters. These topics are not part of the news and do not make it possible to attribute effects on the cross-border worker’s rules, deductions or benefits to Centro Ovale.
## Useful planning tools To estimate your pension strategy, use the pension planner and the pillar 3 simulator. To follow the matter without confusing announcements and decisions, a cross-border commuter can stick to four checks, all anchored in the available data. The method helps determine when a formal step becomes operational information, without filling the gaps with hypotheses.
1. Separate the bankruptcy from the ownership. Ellipticum’s bankruptcy was decreed by the Mendrisio Magistrate’s Court, but the SA’s appeal has suspensive effect. Until the decision of the Enforcement and Bankruptcy Chamber of the Court of Appeal, the legal case remains open.
2. Await the official use. The fashion multinational is identified as the new owner according to information from RSI, but it has not been clarified whether the building will house production, a retail outlet or something else. This is the first concrete information to await before speaking of services or jobs.
3. Read the institutional contact correctly. Mayor Bruno Arrigoni said that he had requested contact with the new owner’s lawyer and was waiting for a reply for an initial introductory meeting. A meeting does not amount to an opening date: that date is not in the source.
4. Keep the real-estate case separate from the route. The only practical reference is the building at the entrance to Chiasso, after customs. The text does not announce construction work, diversions, closures or new schedules. For crossing times, the tempi attesa valichi tool can be consulted, without attributing to Centro Ovale information that has not been communicated.
This sequence avoids two confusions: considering Ellipticum still operational and treating the multinational as if it had already announced its establishment. The next verifiable development will be the chamber’s decision; the other awaited step is the first contact between the Municipality and the new owner. Only afterward can it be determined whether there will be effects for Chiasso and for those entering the city from customs.

## In brief - The Job Day takes place giovedì 1° ottobre, from 9.30 to 14.00 - Event at Villa Gallia and Villa Saporiti - 28 public and local organizations are on the program - Free participation with registration on Eventbrite

Giovedì 1° ottobre, from 9.30 to 14.00, Villa Gallia and Villa Saporiti will host the Public Administration Job Day. The initiative is intended for those who want to learn more about public-sector work, the professional opportunities available and how to access the various institutions.
During the day, it will be possible to meet 28 public and local organizations directly. Representatives will present the activities of the institutions, the professional profiles they are seeking, open competitions and how to take part in the selection processes. Direct interaction will make it possible to gather information and navigate the various career opportunities offered by the Public Administration.
Among the participants are Agenzia delle Entrate, ALER Varese-Como-Monza Brianza- Busto Arsizio, ASCI – Azienda Sociale Comuni Insieme, ASF Autolinee, Azalea Cooperativa Sociale, Azienda Sociale Lariana, Azienda Sociale Comasca Lariana, Camera di Commercio Como-Lecco, Casa Circondariale di Como, CFP Como, Como Acqua and several municipalities in the area. The program also includes seminars and in-depth sessions. One of the scheduled events is a meeting on InPA, from application to preparation for the competitive examination, with practical guidance on consulting opportunities, correctly submitting the application and preparing for the tests. The Servizio Civile Universale, the Leva Civica and internship opportunities with Public Administrations will also be covered.
> «With this Job Day, we want to offer citizens, and young people in particular, the opportunity to learn more about a world that often seems complex or not very accessible,» emphasizes Fiorenzo Bongiasca, President of Provincia di Como.

item.title: Tre Valli Varesine: races and road closures
item.description: From 3 to 6 October, Varese and the surrounding province host time trial, granfondo and professional races with significant traffic restrictions.
item.content:encoded:
Domenica 4 ottobre is the most extensive day of the cycling program in Alto Varesotto. Between 9 and 9.40, the Tre Valli Varesine granfondo, 126 kilometers long, and the mediofondo, approximately 100 kilometers long, set off from via Sacco.
### Granfondo, mediofondo and return to Varese
The riders climb into Valganna and then descend toward Ceresio. The route crosses Valmarchirolo and Valcuvia before returning to Varese along the lake, passing through Gavirate and Calcinate del Pesce. The granfondo also includes an extension into Luinese and Valtravaglia, while the mediofondo follows the shorter route indicated in the program.
Outside Varese, the roads are closed as the riders pass and reopened after the end-of-race vehicle. In the city, closures begin at 5 in the center and along the exit toward viale Valganna. From 11, the roads on the return route are also affected. The restrictions last until 18, and the awards ceremony is scheduled for 13.30.
That same Sunday, Varese also hosts Strawoman. The 5-kilometer race and walk starts at 10.30 from Giardini Estensi, adding a city event to the day's calendar.
The sports program also includes Coppa Bernocchi, which starts and finishes in Legnano. The race, described as the oldest of the Trittico Lombardo races, is 177,8 kilometers long and starts at 12.30.
The heart of Coppa Bernocchi is the climb up Piccolo Stelvio, or Caramamma, between Castiglione Olona and Morazzone. The climb is repeated eight times. The finish is scheduled for the first time on via XX settembre in Legnano, in a window between 16.15 and 16.40.
The Sunday therefore brings together events with different distances and routes that pass through several areas of Varesotto. The granfondo and mediofondo take place between Valganna, Ceresio, Valmarchirolo, Valcuvia, Luinese and Valtravaglia; Coppa Bernocchi, on the other hand, links Legnano to the stretches between Castiglione Olona and Morazzone.

item.title: Tilo train stopped in Busto Arsizio for almost three hours
item.description: A Tilo train from Malpensa to Biasca remained stuck about 200 meters from Busto Arsizio station: tension and disruptions on board.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Tilo stationary for almost three hours near Busto Arsizio - Train bound from Malpensa to Biasca - Passengers unable to leave the carriages - Another train pushed it into the station
## Key facts - Location → approximately 200 meters from Busto Arsizio station - Route → Milan Malpensa-Biasca - Duration of the stoppage → almost three hours - Suspected cause → technical fault - Solution → coupling and pushing to the station
### The stoppage near the station
On 28 September 2026, a Tilo train bound from Milan Malpensa to Biasca remained stationary for almost three hours approximately 200 meters from Busto Arsizio station. A Ticinese who was on board the train reported what was happening. Several accounts were sent to the newsroom.
According to the account, passengers could not leave the carriages. As time passed, the situation caused tension among the people on board to rise. The witness described an increasingly exasperated reaction, while numerous expletives can be heard in the audio made available.
According to reports, a technical fault is believed to be behind the stoppage. The train was outside the station, a few hundred meters from the point where passengers would have been able to get off. Italian police were present outside the train and did not allow people to leave the carriages.
The doors were opened from time to time to let air circulate. The account, however, speaks of people left without water and of the presence of small children who were crying. There were also passengers on board who urgently needed to return home.
The stoppage therefore involved people with different needs, all forced to wait inside the train while the situation remained at a standstill near Busto Arsizio station. The source reports that, for a long time, it was not possible to walk to the station or continue the journey toward Biasca. ## The tension inside the carriages
### The accounts collected
The account from the Busto Arsizio area mainly conveys the conditions experienced by passengers while they waited. The train was close to the station, but no one could get off. For those on board, this short distance made the duration of the stoppage even more difficult to understand.
“No one can leave the carriages. The people on board are going crazy. They’re saying all kinds of things,” the witness reported. The audio provided confirms the tense atmosphere: numerous curses can be heard, while the journey toward Biasca remains suspended in the Busto Arsizio area.
The difficulties reported include a lack of water, small children crying and several people urgently expressing their desire to get home. The doors were opened only occasionally to allow air to circulate. Outside, the Italian police prevented passengers from getting off the carriages.
The witness also reported that one person became hysterical and attempted to leave the train to escape by crossing the tracks. The authorities then stopped them. The incident occurred within a situation already marked by the prolonged wait, the impossibility of leaving the train and uncertainty over what solution to adopt.
For a few minutes, the possibility of taking the train back to its departure point began to circulate, so that the passengers could be transferred to another train. The witness explained, however, that it was not yet clear how the operation would be managed and warned that the wait could become even longer.
The prospect fueled frustration among those on board. The train was a few hundred meters from a station, but it remained stopped. The source thus describes a wait accompanied by protests, physical discomfort and questions about how the disruption was being managed. ## The train convoy pushed to the station
### Coupling and moving
The turning point came in the 17.55 update. According to what the witness at the scene explained, a solution had finally been found to move the train from where it was.
Another train coupled to the Tilo convoy and pushed it for about 200 metres, as far as Busto Arsizio station. In this way, after almost three hours of waiting, the passengers arrived at the point that was a few hundred metres from the stopped train.
The account highlights the gap between the short distance and the length of the wait. For the witness, that stretch could have been covered on foot in a few minutes, but the passengers had remained inside the carriages until the intervention of the other train.
The solution made it possible to reach the station, but it did not erase the questions about the preceding hours. The witness hypothesised that being kept in those conditions might have been due to safety reasons. At the same time, he reported that the passengers still had doubts about whether a valid alternative existed for managing the stoppage.
The coupling and pushing represented the decisive stage of the incident: the convoy was brought to the station after having remained stuck a few metres from the arrival point. The source provides no further details about the subsequent arrangements for the journey towards Biasca, nor does it indicate the departure time.
It therefore remains documented that the train’s stoppage near the station was followed by its being moved by another train, after the waiting and agitation experienced on board. The person who had attempted to cross the tracks was also stopped by law enforcement, according to what was reported in the reconstruction.

item.description: In 2026 premiums increase +4,4% on average, higher in Ticino; in 2027 estimate between 4,5% and 5%. Healthcare expenditure 2024: 97 mld CHF. Caisse Santé Genève project on 23/09/2026.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - 2026: +4.4% average increase in premiums - 2027: estimated increase between 4.5% and 5% - 2024 healthcare expenditure: 97 billion francs - Geneva Project: date indicated as September 23, 2026
## Key Facts - 2026 Premiums → +4.4% average - 2027 Premiums → increase between 4.5% and 5% - 2024 Healthcare expenditure → 97 billion francs - Annual growth 2024 → 4.1% - Direct funding → nearly two-thirds - Institution → FOPH - Project → Caisse Santé Genève - Date → September 23, 2026
## The Framework of Price Increases
The source indicates an average increase of +4.4% for 2026 and specifies that the increase is significantly higher for Ticino. For 2027, according to the most recent estimates, a new increase between 4.5% and 5% is expected, with an even heavier price hike in Ticino. Official confirmation from the Confederation is expected within days.
The FOPH — Federal Office of Public Health — acknowledges that premiums are placing an increasing burden on household budgets and have become one of the population's primary concerns. Therefore, the issue is not presented merely as a technical matter for health insurance funds; the source also places it on an economic, social, and political level.
The description of the premiums explains the hardship. For many families, the source writes, they resemble a «mandatory health tax»: it is paid every month, regardless of whether one falls ill or not. To the premium are added the deductible, cost-sharing, and other expenses; when a real health necessity arises, the bill can become even heavier. For the reader seeking an overview of health insurance, this is the economic mechanism highlighted.
### From Expenditure to Family Budgets
In 2024, the overall expenditure of the Swiss healthcare system reached 97 billion francs, with an increase of 4.1% in a single year. Nearly two-thirds of the funding fell directly on households through premiums and out-of-pocket payments. The source links these figures to the transformation of the problem into an issue that transcends healthcare alone.
When health absorbs a larger portion of income, the text observes, resources are taken away from the home, children, consumption, and savings, even affecting the possibility of living with dignity. This leads to the question regarding the numerous health insurance funds, each with its own structures, administrations, and organizational costs, and the hypothesis of a single fund for basic insurance.
The source text sets September 23, 2026, as the date for the concrete progress of the «Caisse Santé Genève» project. The transition includes two procedures to build a new model for a cantonal health network and insurance. The stated goal is to contain the explosion of premiums and costs. ## Meaning for budgets
For the cross-border worker reading this information, the verifiable link remains territorial: the source reports a heavier price increase in Ticino and describes the growing burden on household economies. item.description: The Swiss PLR disputes the VAT increase to 8.5% to finance the 13th AVS. The popular vote is scheduled for November 29.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - PLR launches opposition to the VAT increase for the 13th AVS pension - Standard rate: +0.4 percentage points, to 8.5% - The popular vote is scheduled for 29 November - The arguments were presented in Bern
## Key facts - Who → Swiss PLR - Subject → financing the 13th AVS pension through VAT - Increase → 0.4 percentage points, to 8.5% - Approval → in June by the Chambers - Deadline → popular vote on 29 November
Swiss PLR launched today, Monday, the campaign against the VAT increase intended to finance the 13th AVS pension. The party presented its arguments at a press conference in Bern.
The people will vote on the increase in the popular vote on 29 November. The issue put to a vote, according to the PLR's account, does not amount to a dispute over the payment of the 13th AVS pension. What is considered unacceptable is the method chosen to finance it.
### The contested increase
The target is the increase in the standard rate of 0.4 percentage points, to 8.5%, approved by the Chambers in June. PLR describes the increase as harmful to purchasing power and the economy. Its criticism therefore concerns the burden of the measure and the way in which it should support the financing of the benefit.
At the press conference, the party linked the additional burden to household budgets. According to the argument made in Bern, these budgets are already being put under severe strain by increases in health insurance premiums, rents and current expenses. The source does not indicate an individual amount or provide a simulation for individual categories.
PLR also disputes the adequacy of the financing. Co-president Susanne Vincenz-Stauffacher argues: «Less than half is financed by this poorly drafted proposal». For the party, therefore, the vote brings together criticism of the cost for households and criticism of the solution's ability to cover the financing of the 13th AVS pension. To delve further into the pension provision section, the reader can consult the guide on AVS e LPP.
The framework provided by the party therefore contains a political assessment on two fronts: the impact of the standard rate and the solution's ability to finance the benefit. The text attributes both assessments to PLR and presents no alternative calculation. The campaign remains focused on the choice of instrument, while the payment of the 13th AVS pension is not called into question. For the cross-border commuter following the debate, the practical key is to distinguish the payment of the 13th AVS pension from its financing. The source says that the former is not being called into question by the PLR; the campaign instead concerns the increase in VAT and the standard rate set at 8,5% after an increase of 0,4 percentage points.
This distinction prevents turning the vote into a decision described by the source as being in favor of or opposed to the 13th itself. The issue identified is the cost of the solution. The PLR links it to purchasing power and the economy, while regarding households it speaks of an additional burden that would weigh heavily on budgets already under pressure from health insurance premiums, rent and current expenses.
### The scope for those living across the border
For a cross-border commuter, the text does not make it possible to calculate a change in pay, net income or personal budget. It does not report individual amounts, consumption, wages or a breakdown of the burden among categories of people. Nor does it provide a separate impact for Canton Ticino.
To avoid conflating different issues, the source does not address the G permit, LPP, LAMal, withholding tax, tax rebates, INPS or double taxation. These references therefore cannot be used to attribute to the news a consequence that the text does not describe. The only concrete connection provided by the article is the general reference to household budgets and current expenses.
Also outside the text are the exact amount of the additional burden for a single household, any possible difference between personal circumstances and a numerical measure of overall coverage. The article does not provide these figures; therefore, the political position should be read as a campaign argument, not as a simulation of every reader's budget.
The assessment of whether the funding is sufficient must also be correctly attributed. It is not presented as a neutral fact or as an independent calculation: it is the judgment of the PLR, expressed by co-president Susanne Vincenz-Stauffacher, according to which less than half would be financed by the project. For the section on premiums cited in the source, an in-depth analysis is available at assicurazione malattia.
## Useful planning tools To estimate your pension strategy, use the pension planner and the pillar 3 simulator. To follow the vote without attributing to the source numbers it does not contain, the cross-border worker can organize the reading into four steps.
### A practical fact sheet
1. Identify the measure. This concerns the increase in VAT intended to finance the 13th AVS, not a dispute over its payment. 2. Establish the numerical figure. The standard rate increases by 0,4 percentage points and reaches 8,5%; the increase was approved in June by the Chambers. 3. Separate the arguments. The PLR identifies as risks the damage to purchasing power and the economy, the burden on household budgets, and coverage deemed insufficient. The party links the pressure on budgets to health insurance premiums, rent, and current expenses. 4. Note the date. The decision will go before the people in the popular vote of 29 novembre. The source does not anticipate the outcome and does not describe the next step.
This outline makes it possible to keep political facts separate from personal assessments. If the reader is estimating their own budget, they cannot derive from this text a withholding, an increase in monthly spending, or a specific effect on income: none of these amounts is indicated. They can instead use the available data to understand which part of the measure the PLR contests and what reasons it gives in support of a no vote.

The route is planned near the former plant nursery area, in the municipal territory of Carlazzo, along SP 10 della Val Cavargna.

The minimum wage in the hospitality and catering sector will increase by 0.6% in 2027. The decision was set by the sector’s social partners and corresponds to expected inflation, according to a joint statement issued in Basel.
The agreement was communicated by the employer organisations GastroSuisse, HotellerieSuisse and Swiss Catering Association, together with the worker representatives Hotel & Gastro Union, Syna and Unia. The adjustment concerns the sector’s minimum wages and stems from a mechanism that the employer organisations and trade unions had already agreed on last year.
The decision is based on the inflation forecasts of the State Secretariat for Economic Affairs, identified in the source by the acronym SECO. The increase is therefore presented by the social partners as an adjustment to the expected inflation for 2027.
### The decision of the social partners
For an employee holding a federal certificate of practical training or an equivalent qualification, i.e. Cat. II, the gross monthly salary will rise from 4'070 to 4'094 francs. The change therefore concerns a minimum level expressed in gross monthly francs and is not described in the source as a general change to all wages in the sector.
The move from 4'070 to 4'094 francs is the only quantified wage level in the statement. The statement identifies the profile through the federal certificate of practical training or the equivalent qualification and lists the amounts as gross monthly salary.
In the statement, the parties specify that this agreement allows them to «focus on negotiations concerning the new collective labour agreement». ## The mechanism already agreed
The increase announced for 2027 does not stem from negotiations started from scratch. The employers' organizations and the sector's trade unions had already agreed last year on the mechanism used to determine the adjustment. The decision now communicated therefore applies a criterion already shared by the social partners.
The parameter referred to is the expected rise in prices. SECO's inflation forecasts form the basis on which 0.6% was set for the minimum wages in the hotel and catering sector. The source does not attribute the announcement to a single person: it presents it as a joint position of the employers' associations and workers' representatives.
On one side are GastroSuisse, HotellerieSuisse and Swiss Catering Association. On the other are Hotel & Gastro Union, Syna and Unia. These are the organizations listed in the joint statement accompanying the agreement and that indicated the correspondence between the increase and the expected rise in prices.
### The effect on Cat. II
The most concrete point concerns Cat. II. The reference is to an employee with a federal certificate of practical training or an equivalent qualification. For this profile, the gross monthly amount rises from 4'070 to 4'094 francs. The difference reported by the source is therefore between two gross monthly amounts, while the percentage set by the social partners is 0.6%.
The agreement is not presented merely as a numerical update. The source does not indicate the outcome of those negotiations and does not provide any other amounts for categories other than Cat. II.
The picture described therefore remains limited to the announced data: a mechanism already agreed, an inflation forecast from SECO and the adjustment of the minimum wage planned for 2027. ## When the seasonal increases will take effect
For seasonal contracts, the increase in minimum wages will not come into force through one single, undifferentiated date. The joint note indicates that the increases will be applied at the beginning of the summer season.
The timeline reported by the social partners is precise: the winter season ends no later than 30 April 2027. The summer season begins the following day, on 1 May 2027. For seasonal contracts, therefore, the start of the summer season marks the entry into force of the minimum wage increases.

Over 20mila toys intended for children, more than 300 electrical devices and about 300 textile products were seized during inspections carried out in recent days by the Guardia di Finanza of Varese at various commercial establishments in Busto Arsizio and Saronno. The tally also includes three merchants sanctioned and two reported for commercial fraud.
### The inspections and seizures
The Busto Arsizio Group and the Saronno Company operated as part of the provincial inspection effort against the sale of non-compliant and potentially dangerous products. Irregularities emerged in goods displayed for sale in three stores.
In two commercial establishments in Busto Arsizio, run by Chinese nationals, officers seized about 20mila toys intended for children and more than 300 electrical devices. The items were found to lack the necessary safety requirements.
The source reports that some of the products lacked the CE marking, necessary to certify compliance with European standards concerning safety, health and environmental protection. On other items, the mark was present but non-compliant, with the risk of misleading buyers about the goods’ actual safety characteristics.
In Saronno, by contrast, Guardia di Finanza officers inspected a store run by Italian nationals. About 300 textile products lacking the minimum mandatory information about the characteristics of the items were identified and seized there. The total value of the seized goods exceeds 30mila euro.
At the end of the investigations, the three owners were reported to the competent Chamber of Commerce for administrative penalties, assessed at approximately 10mila euro in total. The two merchants from Busto Arsizio were also reported to the Public Prosecutor’s Office for commercial fraud, an offense provided for by article 515 of the criminal code, for selling products of a quality different from that declared.

On Friday, September 25, in the morning, Società Canottieri Varese and Nagano Rowing Association signed a twinning agreement and international partnership via video conference. The signing connected the historic headquarters in Schiranna with the Japanese authorities gathered in Shimosuwa, giving shape to an agreement built on cultural exchanges, shared training, technical development and local synergies between Italy and Japan.
Connected from Schiranna were Canottieri Varese president Paolo Consonni and Varese deputy mayor Ivana Perusin. From Japan, Yoshiki Kinoshita, federal president of the Nagano Rowing Association, and Toru Miyasaka, mayor of Shimosuwa, took part. The signing came after an initial virtual contact between the youngsters of the two clubs, which took place last year.
### The agreement and its Olympic roots
The roots of the agreement date back to the welcome extended to the Italian delegation during the 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games. Kinoshita recalled that Shimosuwa had welcomed thirty-six members of the Italian national team. On that occasion, technical director Francesco Cattaneo had introduced the group by saying that he had the strongest team in the world; the president of the Nagano Rowing Association linked that assessment to the medals won.
> «Varese is one of the nerve centers of Italian rowing,» said Yoshiki Kinoshita.
In his remarks, the Japanese president described the friendship with a club rich in history and tradition as a source of great joy. He identified contact with Varese's culture and passion as a particular stimulus for younger athletes, considered the future of the sport. The stated aim is to safeguard and nurture the bond, making the collaboration an opportunity to make rowing even more fascinating.
Consonni presented the twinning as an important step for the Varese club. He recalled that the shared passion for oars narrows an enormous geographical distance and identified 2027 as the first major showcase for an in-person meeting. On that occasion, Canottieri Varese intends to welcome the Japanese crews at the Schiranna course. The simultaneous signing of the official documents and the final photographs closed the ceremony, bringing the tradition of the club and the city toward an international dimension. ## In brief - Varese-Lentigione on Sunday 27 September at 15 - The match will be played at the Franco Ossola in Masnago - The red-and-whites are coming off a win over Pontedera - Lentigione lost 1-0 against Cittadella Modena
## Key facts | Field | Value | |---|---| | Match | Varese-Lentigione | | Date | Sunday 27 September | | Time | 15 | | Stadium | Franco Ossola, Masnago | | Varese coach | Andrea Ciceri | | Lentigione coach | Pedrelli | | Varese's latest win | away at Pontedera | | Lentigione's latest defeat | 1-0 at home against Cittadella Modena |
Varese return to Masnago after securing their first league win away at Pontedera. The red-and-whites now seek further confirmation in front of their home crowd, with a fixture scheduled at the Franco Ossola for Sunday 27 September at 15.
Opposing them will be Lentigione, an Emilia-based team that opened the league season with three consecutive wins. The run ended in the home match lost 1-0 against Cittadella Modena. Varese are therefore preparing to host a team coming off a negative result, but which had recorded three wins in its first outings.
### A test of maturity at Masnago
For the team led by Andrea Ciceri, the match represents a test of maturity. The coach linked the first win of the season to the need to continue along the same path. In his assessment of the matches played so far, Ciceri distinguished results from performances: the contexts, qualities and strategies of the opponents have changed, while his assessment remains positive of the way Varese have held their own on the pitch.
The home fixture thus takes on a precise meaning in the coach's words. Varese want to turn their home stadium into a constant, playing there more consistently and seeking a flow of play tied to the dimensions of the pitch and the spaces to attack. The coach did warn, however, that the challenge will be different from the previous outings, because Lentigione offer aggression, forward play and attacks into space.
> «We are facing a very aggressive team that plays forward and attacks the spaces».
The matchup therefore puts Varese up against an opponent with an attacking identity described directly by Ciceri. The team will have to contend with this approach in a match that comes after the win at Pontedera and gives the red-and-whites the chance to build on the result. The transition from the away trip to the match at the Franco Ossola is the central point ahead of the game: Varese return to their home ground and try to make their performances in front of the Masnago crowd more consistent. ## Lentigione's profile and Varese's choices
### An opponent built for professional football
Ciceri's assessment of Lentigione starts from one precise fact: in the coach's view, it is a top-level team. Over the last two years, he explained, the Emilian side has lost very little. Last week brought the first defeat of the season, after a perfect start.
The coach also recalled that last year Lentigione fought for the title until the final matchdays. The club is described as structured to aim for professional football, with very valuable players chosen very well. Completing the picture is coach Pedrelli, whom Ciceri credits with well-defined playing principles.
According to Ciceri, the greatest dangers do not concern only the quality of the Emilian side. Lentigione comes into the match wanting to bounce back after its latest defeat. To face it, Varese will have to play under pressure, deny depth, compete for second balls and exploit the little space the opponents habitually allow.
### Midfield options and the Cogliati situation
The coach also spoke about the arrival of two new midfielders. Their presence, he explained, does not create difficulties; on the contrary, it gives him and the team a greater number of options. Internal competition stems from the way the players train, always at high intensity.
Carbone has been with Varese since the start of preseason. Ciceri has seen him training well and considers the opportunity he is being given deserved. Piantoni, on the other hand, arrived somewhat unexpectedly at the last moment. His addition was described as targeted: besides fitting the team's needs in terms of his characteristics, he is an under-age player and immediately took the field because an element with those qualities was needed.
Cogliati's situation remains to be assessed. The player has a rib problem that bothers him somewhat, but he is trying to recover. The decision on his availability will be made at the very last moment, because he is considered a fundamental player for Varese. The assessment of his physical condition thus adds to the midfield choices and the preparation for a match in which Ciceri is demanding attention to second balls, depth and the available space. ### The Matches and the Standings

## The verdict in Varese On venerdì 25 settembre, at the end of the hearing that opened shortly after 9:30 a.m. with the sound of the bell, the Varese Court of Assizes delivered its verdict in the trial against Marco Manfrinati.
The defendant, accused of the murder of Fabio Limido and the attempted murder of Lavinia Limido, was sentenced to life imprisonment. The operative part of the judgment also provides for two months of daytime isolation. The proceedings concern the events that took place on 6 maggio 2024 on via Ciro Menotti, in the Casbeno district.
### The courtroom confrontation Manfrinati was not present in the courtroom. His defense attorney, Elio Giannangeli, returned to the general mitigating circumstances and premeditation, which the defense had already asked to have excluded.
At the opening, attorney Fabio Ambrosetti, representing the family acting as civil party, announced that on 14 ottobre the Cassazione will rule on the final level of judgment in the stalking trial.
The rebuttals then followed. Prosecutor Claudia Maria Contini focused on the aggravating circumstances of stalking and premeditation, as well as on the mitigating circumstance requested by the defense for the unjust act of another, namely provocation. Ambrosetti joined the prosecution’s conclusions.
The prosecutor argued that:
> «Fabio Limido had been in the crosshairs for years».
After the reading of the operative part of the judgment, the defense announced an appeal. Varese Public Prosecutor Antonio Gustapane expressed appreciation for the verdict of the Court of Assizes, describing it as proportionate to the charges brought against the defendant. ## Reading the aggravating circumstances
### Two counts, different assessments The operative part distinguishes between the two offenses charged against Marco Manfrinati. Premeditation was recognized only for the attempted murder of Lavinia Limido. For the murder of Fabio Limido, however, the same aggravating circumstance was not recognized.
Stalking was recognized for both counts. The remaining aggravating circumstances related to cruelty and diminished ability to defend oneself were instead dropped. The decision therefore contains different assessments depending on the fact examined: premeditation concerns only one of the two counts, while stalking concerns both.

## In brief - Varese lose at home to Virtus Bologna - Kastritis points to approach and physicality as the differences - The team nearly erases the deficit in the third quarter - Della Valle is assessed day by day
## Key facts - Game → Pallacanestro Varese-Virtus Bologna - Venue → Masnago - Varese coach → Giannis Kastritis - Virtus coach → Mumbru - Next away game indicated → Scafati - Della Valle's situation → Assessment day by day
Pallacanestro Varese lost at Masnago to Virtus Bologna. At the end of the home defeat, coach Giannis Kastritis spoke of disappointment at the result, but also of clear-headedness in his analysis. For the Biancorossi coach, the first difference was in the approach to the game and the opponents' physical impact from the opening tip.
Kastritis praised Virtus, who arrived at Masnago with a perfect approach and great solidity from the first minute. Varese knew how dangerous the Bologna team was on the boards and in offensive transition, but in the opening minutes they were slower to react and match the initial intensity. For the coach, this gap affected the course of the game.
The coach did not, however, want to place the blame on his players. Virtus, he explained, is one of the strongest teams in the league, and its performance can serve as an example of how to play at this level.
### The reaction in the third quarter
In the third quarter, Pallacanestro Varese made a major effort. The team managed to match Virtus's physical level and do the right things on both ends of the court, almost completely erasing the deficit. The comeback was not completed, however: in the fourth quarter, on two or three key possessions, Varese was unable to stay within reach.
Kastritis recalled that many players have had physical problems in recent weeks and are not yet at their best, despite having worked hard. The coach ruled out the absences of the two sidelined players becoming an excuse. For several players, the game represented their first exposure to the rhythm, speed and physicality of Italian basketball.
The game, in the coach's assessment, therefore serves to understand where the team stands and what it needs in order to grow. The next fixture indicated is the away game in Scafati. As for Della Valle, the situation is being assessed day by day together with the medical staff: the player is eager to return and the group is waiting to have him available again when he is ready.
The crowd also played a role in the evening. The fans filled the arena, creating a fantastic atmosphere, even though Varese was unable to reciprocate with a win. ## Two readings of the same game
The defeat in Masnago emerges from the assessments of the two coaches, who observe the game from different perspectives. Giannis Kastritis insisted on Virtus's start and on Varese's need to adapt to the opponents' intensity. Mumbru, instead, highlighted his players' response after the return journey from Istanbul and their ability to maintain energy in a game made difficult by the atmosphere in the arena.
The black-and-white coach credited his players with finding the right energy. He also admitted that Varese had important absences, but stressed the concentration maintained for almost all 40 minutes of play. In his account, the game remained open when the home side closed the gap.
### Virtus's plan
Mumbru explained that, during the comeback, Virtus temporarily lost aggression in defense and balance in attack. The team nevertheless managed to regain control of the game. The plan prepared in a short time involved limiting Varese's three-point shooting percentages, controlling the rebounds and moving the ball well against the red-and-white team's defensive aggression.
These elements complete Kastritis's reading. The game is not described solely as a contest decided by the final result, but as a confrontation in which Varese had to contend with the physicality, speed and consistency of one of the strongest teams in the league. The response in the third quarter showed the possibility of closing the gap; the fourth-quarter possessions instead marked the limit indicated by the coach.
Mumbru then placed his team at 60% compared with the Super Cup, 10% more than a few days ago. He explained that new players are coming in and that the process is proceeding step by step, because so far a full training session has never been held. item.title: Dumenza, three home burglaries and one failed attempt
item.description: Three homes targeted in Dumenza on the evening of Friday, September 25: cash, gold and money stolen. A fourth attempt failed.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Three thefts committed in Dumenza in a single evening - Via Santuario, via Fiume and via Dante targeted - 600 euros, gold and other money stolen - A fourth break-in failed on via XX Settembre
## Key facts - When → Friday 25 September - Where → Dumenza - Completed thefts → three - Failed attempts → one - Money stolen → 600 euros on via Santuario - Streets affected → via Santuario, via Fiume, via Dante and via XX Settembre - Investigations → Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station
### The four incidents
Three home burglaries successfully carried out and a fourth failed attempt over the course of a single evening. This is the sequence recorded in Dumenza on Friday 25 September, where several homes were targeted by unknown perpetrators.
On via Santuario, the thieves managed to enter a home and took 600 euros in cash. Another theft was reported on via Fiume: in this case too, the criminals managed to enter a house and, after searching for valuables, took gold.
A third theft was committed in a home on via Dante. In this case, the haul consisted of gold and money, taken before the perpetrators managed to get away and disappear without a trace.
The situation was different on via XX Settembre. The unknown individuals heard the owners inside the home and decided to flee. The theft was not completed, but in this incident too the perpetrators managed to disappear without a trace.
The incidents affected four streets in the small municipality north of Varese. In three homes the theft was completed, while in the fourth case the attempt was interrupted after the owners were heard inside the house. The people concerned reported the incidents to the Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station. ## The targeted homes
The reconstruction of the cases begins on via Santuario, where the reported haul was 600 euros in cash. On via Fiume, by contrast, the perpetrators searched for valuables inside the home and took gold.
The third incident, on via Dante, involved a haul consisting of gold and money. The perpetrators managed to get away after taking whatever they found in the home, disappearing without a trace. On via XX Settembre, the outcome was different: the presence of the owners prompted the unknown individuals to flee before the theft could be completed.
### Hauls and outcomes
| Street | Outcome | Haul or circumstances | |---|---|---| | via Santuario | Completed theft | 600 euros in cash | | via Fiume | Completed theft | Gold | | via Dante | Completed theft | Gold and money | | via XX Settembre | Failed attempt | The owners were at home |
The string of incidents is described as unfortunately record-breaking for the small municipality. The figure concerns the concentration of the incidents: three completed thefts and a fourth attempted break-in on the same evening. The homes are located on different streets, but all within the territory of Dumenza.
The evening thus resulted in four reports with two distinct outcomes. On the one hand, the thieves managed to enter three homes and steal cash, gold, or both. On the other, the attempt on via XX Settembre ended when the unknown individuals heard the residents. After fleeing, the perpetrators of the three completed thefts also disappeared without a trace.
The available information links the individual incidents to their respective addresses: via Santuario for the 600 euros, via Fiume for the gold, via Dante for gold and money, via XX Settembre for the failed attempt. The Dumenza Carabinieri Station is now focusing its investigations on this sequence. ## The Carabinieri investigation
Following reports from the people concerned, the Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station are carrying out investigations to reconstruct what happened and try to identify those responsible for the thefts.
The investigators' work concerns the sequence recorded on the evening of Friday 25 September, with three completed thefts and a fourth attempt that was not carried through. The checks concern the homes indicated on Via Santuario, Via Fiume, Via Dante and Via XX Settembre, where the incidents described occurred.
For the failed break-in, the reported circumstance is the presence of the owners inside the house. After hearing them, the unknown individuals decided to flee. In the other three cases, however, the perpetrators managed to enter the homes, take the items mentioned and leave without a trace.
### The request to residents
The appeal to the public is to report to the Carabinieri any suspicious people or cars noticed on Friday evening in the areas concerned. The request concerns not only the streets where the homes were targeted, but more generally the territory of Dumenza.
Any detail could prove useful to the investigation. For this reason, both observations possibly made in the areas of Via Santuario, Via Fiume, Via Dante and Via XX Settembre, and those collected in other areas of the municipality on the same evening, are being recalled.
Residents' reports add to those already submitted by the people affected by the thefts. The investigations by the Carabinieri of the local Station will reconstruct what happened and try to identify those responsible for the sequence of incidents recorded in Dumenza.

On 25 settembre, the Como State Police arrested two Italian nationals as part of the investigation into the robbery at the Stroili jewelry store inside the Bennet in Tavernola. The operation was coordinated by the Public Prosecutor’s Office and carried out pursuant to a pretrial detention order issued by the GIP of Como.
They are a 32-year-old resident of Switzerland and a 25-year-old resident of the province of Monza. According to the evidence gathered during the investigation, the two are believed to have been involved in the heist committed on 24 aprile, when four people with their faces covered reached the shopping center in a rental car.
The robbery took place within a few minutes. While one of the group waited in the car, the others entered the jewelry store armed with a pistol and with their faces concealed by balaclavas. They threatened the employees and smashed the glass display cases with hammers, taking numerous gold jewelry items.
The total value of the stolen jewelry was estimated at approximately 90mila euro. Due to its manner and speed, the action was described as resembling a scene from a Hollywood action film. ## The investigation into the gang
### The previous arrests
The arrests on September 25 represent a new stage in the investigative activity launched after the assault on the Bennet jewelry store in Tavernola. The Como Mobile Squad reconstructed the participants’ roles and gathered evidence considered significant against all those involved in the robbery.
The investigation also concerns the mastermind behind the heist. The source reports that the most recent operation forms part of a broader context, in which the other three members of the gang had already been arrested in April and May 2026. The robbery had been committed by four individuals, with tasks divided between those waiting outside and those entering the store.
During the investigations following the arrests, searches were carried out. Those activities also uncovered part of the stolen goods, before they could be fenced. The recovered jewelry was returned to the Stroili jewelry store, which had been targeted in the assault.
The reconstruction includes several details described by investigators: the rental car used to reach Bennet, the covered faces, the gun shown to the employees, and the hammers used to smash the display cases’ glass. The haul consisted of numerous gold jewelry items, taken within a matter of minutes.
The Mobile Squad’s work focused both on the actual execution of the robbery and on identifying the participants and the alleged mastermind. The previous arrests and searches added details to the reconstruction of the heist and enabled some of the jewelry to be recovered. ## What happens now
### The procedural phase
After notification of the pretrial detention order, the two men arrested on 25 September were taken to the Como Prison. Their position remains linked to the investigation records and the evidence gathered by the Como State Police, coordinated by the Public Prosecutor’s Office.
The next step indicated by the source is the confirmation in court of the evidence that emerged during the investigations. The arrests were carried out on the basis of the order issued by the GIP of Como, while the strength of the evidence gathered will have to be verified in the proceedings.
From an investigative standpoint, the most recent operation fits into a sequence that had already led to the arrest of the other three members of the gang in the months of April and May 2026. The searches had also made it possible to recover some of the jewelry stolen from Stroili and return it to the store.
The matter remains focused on the proceedings relating to the robbery on 24 April at Bennet in Tavernola. The elements cited include the haul of approximately 90mila euro, the involvement of four individuals with different roles, the use of a rental car and the action carried out with a pistol, balaclava and hammers.
For the two arrested men, the next stage will therefore be the procedural one, identified in the records as the venue for confirmation of the investigative evidence. Until that stage, the reconstruction remains the one that emerged from the work of the State Police, the Como Mobile Squad and the Public Prosecutor’s Office.

## In brief
- Sergi and Pronzini ask for clarifications about Zali's pension entitlement - The order dismissing the case is dated 6 marzo 2019 - The advance withdrawal indicated is approximately 700mila franchi - The questions concern calculation, reduction and insurance period
- Main figures → Giuseppe Sergi and Matteo Pronzini, Mps deputies - Subject → Claudio Zali's pension case - Decision → order signed by Attorney General Andrea Pagani - Withdrawal → approximately 700mila franchi - Effective date → pension entitlement starting on 1° ottobre - Reform → parliamentary amendment during 2020
### The interpellation reopens an issue already discussed
Claudio Zali's departure from the Council of State of the Canton of Ticino prompted Giuseppe Sergi and Matteo Pronzini, Mps deputies, to submit an interpellation to the government. The two are asking for clarifications about the pension entitlement of the Lega minister who resigned and argue that his pension case is still far from clear. The issue had already emerged in 2018, after Pronzini's reports.
The reports led, in March of the following year, to an order dismissing the case signed by Attorney General Andrea Pagani with regard to Zali. The measure concerned the advance withdrawal intended to finance his primary residence, requested and obtained by the State Councillor in March 2016. The date indicated for the order is 6 marzo 2019.
### The move from the Court of Appeal to the government
Sergi and Pronzini start from that order. According to the interpellation, when Zali moved from the Court of Appeal to the Council of State, the occupational pension contributions were taken in by the Canton of Ticino, as provided for by the cited law. In return, the years spent in the service of the State as a teacher and magistrate would have been counted as years of service on the Council of State to determine the pension entitlement upon leaving the government.
The two parliamentarians' reading is that Zali had been entitled to the maximum pension entitlement from day one without paying a franc in pension contributions. They link this situation to the former pension rules for State Councillors, which they describe as still valid for the majority of the members of the current Executive.
The administrative chronology includes further steps. On 28 settembre 2015, an internal opinion from Ipct, sent by email to the entire Council of State by the then deputy director, indicated that the advance withdrawal would have an impact on the future pension entitlement. On 27 novembre 2015, Zali forwarded to Ipct the application for an advance withdrawal, a pledge arrangement and authorization for a registration notice in the land registry, for approximately 700mila franchi. On 2 dicembre 2015, the Council of State granted the withdrawal through a government resolution and indicated that it would entail a reduction in the pension entitlement. The amount had been reported by Corriere del Ticino on 8 maggio 2018.
During 2020, parliament amended the remuneration and pension provisions of members of the Executive. The resolution had reserved the right to review the calculation of the insurance period in the event of future rules. The questions now concern the reference annual salary, who calculated the pension entitlement Zali will receive starting on 1° ottobre, the percentage reduction linked to the 700mila franchi, and the effects of the amendment on the insurance period. ## What a cross-border worker can infer
### The source's practical limitation
For someone who is a cross-border worker and works in Ticino, the news has a precise scope. The text concerns Claudio Zali's pension and the operation of the pension scheme for members of the cantonal Executive. It does not present a change concerning the G permit, AVS, LPP, LAMal, remittances or withholding tax. These topics are not linked to the interpellation.
This distinction is necessary to avoid automatically transposing the case into the everyday life of a commuter. The approximately 700 thousand francs mentioned in the interpellation are the amount of the withdrawal requested by Zali and granted by the Council of State in the case described. The source does not present them as a parameter for a payslip or for the contributions of a cross-border worker. Nor does it provide a final value for the pension, an already calculated percentage or a reference annual salary: these are precisely some of the points on which Sergi and Pronzini are asking for an answer.
The text nevertheless makes it possible to distinguish three aspects. The first is the pension position accrued in the transition from the Appeals Court to the Council of State. The second is the effect that Ipct's internal opinion and the resolution of 2 December 2015 attributed to the early withdrawal. The third is the possible consequence of the 2020 parliamentary amendment on the calculation of the insurance period. The interpellation does not say that these three aspects have already been brought together in a definitive calculation.
For the cross-border reader, the question to keep in mind is therefore which information is documented and which remains to be clarified. The source documents the existence of the political request and reconstructs the cited acts; it does not document a new rule for those who cross the border. To navigate the separate topics of Permesso G/B and AVS/LPP e rendita, it is better not to use this case as a substitute for a specific guide. The topic of withholding tax is also not addressed by the article.
The most prudent reading is this: the case concerns an individual position held by a State Councillor, the rules applicable to that role and the questions addressed to the government. As long as the available material does not include the calculation, the response to the questions and the exact effects of the 2020 reform, any further conclusion about the pension treatment of a cross-border worker would remain outside the source.

item.title: Varese-Season 1-1: Manganese for 95'rigour
item.description: Varese snatches a point from Lentigione thanks to Mangano’s decisive save in stoppage time, after Beretta’s goal and Bontempi’s equalizer.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Beretta puts Varese ahead in the 4th minute - Bontempi equalizes in the 40th minute of the second half - Mangano saves Nappo's penalty in stoppage time - Varese-Lentigione ends 1-1
## Key facts - Match → Varese-Lentigione 1-1 - Lead → Beretta in the 4th minute of the first half - Equalizer → Bontempi in the 40th minute of the second half - Decisive save → Mangano saves Nappo's penalty - Stadium → Franco Ossola - Next fixture → Crema - Coppa Italia → Pro Patria at Masnago on Wednesday 7 October
### A point defended in stoppage time In the 4th minute of the first half, Varese broke the deadlock against Lentigione. Beretta exchanged passes with Favale, entered the box and beat Mosca with an inside-foot touch that went in at the far post. The goal put the biancorossi 1-0 up after a strong start. Varese's defense held firm and the lead stood without much trouble, although Varese's attack failed to make an impact.
The match remained 1-0 to the biancorossi until the end of the second half. The visitors, who played almost entirely in Varese's half in the second half, increased the pressure and in the 40th minute found space for the equalizer. Jassey crossed from the right, Bontempi was left unmarked in the box and headed in the 1-1.
After the goal, Lentigione continued to push. Almost as the five minutes of stoppage time were about to expire, another turning point came: the referee awarded the Emilian side a penalty for Bruzzone pulling Bontempi. Nappo took it, but Mangano guessed the side and saved the shot. The penalty duel was thus won by the Varese goalkeeper, who preserved the 1-1 and allowed the team to take at least a point.
The result moves the team up the table, but cannot make the Franco Ossola happy, as it had hoped to celebrate the season's first home win. Varese had the lead, defended it for a long time and then risked losing it late on. Mangano's save prevented Lentigione's comeback and secured the draw, leaving the biancorossi with a point after a second half considered too passive. ## The match setup
### The initial choices The return to the Franco Ossola came after Varese had broken the duck at Pontedera with their first league win. The Biancorossi were therefore looking to give their fans the season's first home joy. However, a far-from-soft Lentigione arrived at Masnago, a team aiming for a high finish in the table and coming off three consecutive wins before being beaten 1-0 at home by Cittadella Modena.
Ciceri set Varese up in a 4-3-3, dropping De Ponti back into defense to make room for Piantoni in midfield alongside Malinverno and Beretta. Favale, Barzotti and Bianchi started up front. Lentigione chose the same formation. Pedrelli, suspended, was replaced on the bench by Costa; in midfield the visitors fielded former player Battistello, while Mascanzoni, with Jassey and Alessandrini, led the attacking line.
### The first-half chances The opening minutes were a feeling-out period, until the first Biancorossi attack. In the 6th minute, Varese tried to double their lead, but Favale struck a poor shot from outside the box after a fine move. Lentigione took a few minutes to make their presence felt, and Mangano was immediately alert to Battistello's through ball for Mascanzoni. In the 13th minute, the goalkeeper came off his line low to stop Alessandrini, played through vertically by Mascanzoni.
Ciceri's side continued to keep danger at bay thanks to high, organized pressing, which allowed them to win back possession well away from Mangano's goal. The match remained without any major chances until the 25th minute, when the referee awarded Lentigione an indirect free kick inside the box. The move had originated from a back pass by Salera, clearly deflected by an opposing attacker, which Mangano had then caught with his hands.
The decision prompted protests from Varese and Ciceri's disapproval. Nappo, however, fired over, prompting a sigh of relief at the Franco Ossola. In the 34th minute, the Emilian side created their real chance of the first half with a ground-based move involving all three attackers: Mascanzoni finished centrally and Mangano parried.
Late in the half, Lentigione tried to push forward with greater intensity. Varese dropped back a few yards, without allowing themselves to be pinned back, and also held firm against the visitors' corners. The Biancorossi side thus reached halftime still maintaining their lead. ## The follow-up between Crema and the Coppa Italia
### The next appointment Next week, Varese will be playing in Crema. The away match is seen as an opportunity to seek another positive result and find the necessary momentum ahead of the next commitment. In fact, on Wednesday, October 7th, Pro Patria will arrive at Masnago for the Coppa Italia challenge.
The course of events is therefore already outlined: first the match in Crema, then the home match against Pro Patria. For Varese, these will be the next two scheduled appointments following the draw with Lentigione, with the search for a positive result and the cup match set in Masnago.
### Varese Match Report The match report lists Mangano in goal; Salera, De Ponti, Bruzzone, and Berbenni in defense; Malinverno, Piantoni, and Beretta in midfield; Favale, Barzotti, and Bianchi in attack. The indicated formation is 4-3-3, with Ciceri as coach.
During the second half, Varese used Sovogui for Favale at 21', Costante for Piantoni at 27', Fabris for Bianchi at 31', Molinari for Beretta at 43', and Tronci for Berbenni at 44'. Gruttadauria, Dodaj, Ndagijimana, and Gallotti were available on the bench.
### Lentigione Match Report Lentigione took the field with Mosca; Capiluppi, Mele, Gobbo, and Bita in defense; Battistello, Nappo, and Giorgi in midfield; Jassey, Mascanzoni, and Alessandrini in attack. The reported formation for the visitors is also 4-3-3.
In the 25th minute of the second half, Bontempi replaced Capiluppi and Chiesa replaced Giorgi. Delti, Addiego Mobilio, Gualtieri, Mordini, Landini, and Buci were on the bench. The match report thus completes the picture of the game before the double stretch of matches awaiting Varese: the away trip to Crema and the Coppa Italia challenge against Pro Patria in Masnago.

item.content:encoded:
## In brief
- The Trofeo Binda returns on Sunday, 14 March 2027. - Cittiglio hosts the Trofeo and the junior race. - The starting location will be unveiled on 16 October. - The two races will finish in Alfredo Binda's hometown.
## Key facts
- Main race → Trofeo Alfredo Binda – Comune di Cittiglio - Junior race → Piccolo Trofeo Alfredo Binda – Valli del Verbano - Date → Sunday, 14 March 2027 - Circuit → UCI Women's WorldTour - Starting announcement → 16 October, at the headquarters of the Comunità Montana Valli del Verbano
### Confirmation for 2027
On Sunday, 14 March 2027, Cittiglio will once again be at the heart of women's cycling with a day built around two competitions. The programme will bring together the Trofeo Alfredo Binda – Comune di Cittiglio, an UCI Women's WorldTour event, and the Piccolo Trofeo Alfredo Binda – Valli del Verbano, reserved for junior women.
The format includes two separate moments on the same day. In the morning, the young riders of the Piccolo Trofeo will race, while in the afternoon it will be the turn of the WorldTour champions. For both races, the finish will be in Cittiglio, Alfredo Binda's hometown. This is where the entire event announced by the Valli del Verbano will conclude.
The announcement about the next edition comes as the Road World Championships are taking place in Montréal. The return of the international classic and the junior race is therefore already set for the date indicated, with Cittiglio once again at the centre of the day dedicated to women's competitions.
The double event brings together different levels of women's cycling: on one hand, the competition reserved for juniors, and on the other, the race included in the UCI Women's WorldTour international circuit. The two races are presented as a single sporting event, with the morning dedicated to the young riders and the afternoon to the elite athletes.
The next edition will therefore not be just one race, but a day structured around two competitions with the same finish. The first piece of information made public is the date; the starting location will be announced at a later time, at the event already scheduled for October. ## The results from Montréal
The announcement of the date is accompanied by two world medals that strengthen the connection between the Cittiglio race and international cycling. The results came during the Road World Championships held in Montréal and concern both categories highlighted by the Binda event.
Matilde Rossignoli, who won the Piccolo Trofeo Binda in Cittiglio last March, won the silver medal in the junior world championship event in Montréal. The young athlete's result directly connects the race reserved for juniors with the world stage: the winner of the last edition mentioned reached the podium in the world championship competition in the same category.
Among the elite, Elisa Longo Borghini won bronze. The cyclist had already won Binda in 2013 and 2021, two previous victories mentioned alongside the new result achieved in Canada. The two medals thus accompany confirmation of the next event and highlight the relationship between the Cittiglio competition and the world championships.

item.content:encoded:
## In brief
- Municipal plan for the school network in 2027/2028 - Via Perti proposed for transfer to IC Como Lago - Nazario Sauro moved to IC Como Borgovico in 2016 - Ilaria Flauto calls for a discussion on educational continuity
## Key facts
- Who → Ilaria Flauto, teacher and vice-principal - School → Nazario Sauro primary school, Via Tomaso Perti - Destination → IC Como Lago - References → points 4.4.4 and 4.4.5 - Resources → PNRR and PN 21-27 - Continuity → from ages three to fourteen
### The disputed transfer
For the 2027/2028 school year, the Municipality of Como proposed a reorganization of the city's school network. The document, included in the debate on the reorganization sought by the administration of Mayor Alessandro Rapinese, indicates in points 4.4.4 and 4.4.5 the transfer of the Via Tomaso Perti school complex to IC Como Lago. The Nazario Sauro Primary School is located in the school complex, the school from which Ilaria Flauto's reflection originates.
Flauto writes in her dual capacity as a teacher at Nazario Sauro and as vice-principal and primary school coordinator for IC Como Borgovico. The assessment she submits to the editorial office is clear-cut: the choice, examined from a pedagogical and regulatory perspective, causes concern and dismay. In her reading, the issue concerns the way the school is viewed: not as a simple sum of numbers or as a school complex to be moved based on accounting or demographic needs, but as a community built over time.
### Continuity as a criterion
The teacher refers to school legislation and the National Guidelines. The Comprehensive Institute, she explains, was created to ensure vertical teaching and educational continuity, from ages three to fourteen. A unified pathway should therefore bring together a cultural, methodological, and social identity rooted in the local area.
Nazario Sauro had already changed institutes in 2016, moving from IC Como Centro Città to IC Como Borgovico. Since then, according to the letter, the teachers' work has built a cohesive and integrated educational community. The phrase Flauto chose to describe this transfer is direct: «In these ten years, we have not been a postal package».
The letter recalls the teamwork and the use of national resources, citing PNRR and PN 21-27. The results mentioned include a shared horizontal and vertical curriculum, continuous teacher training, joint projects in music, sports, art, and language, as well as the design of educational spaces funded by the PNRR.
### The consequences indicated
For Flauto, removing Nazario Sauro from IC Como Borgovico would change its identity, also because the institute is set to be renamed IC Como Nord Ovest and would lose its historic primary school in the city center. The letter also links the closure of Corridoni primary school and the transfer of its student population to IC Como Centro Città to the breaking of continuity with Raschi nursery school and Foscolo secondary school.
The final request is addressed to the institutions: a politely firm, open, and competent discussion, with teaching quality and the stability of students' educational pathways at the center. ## A practical reading of the reorganization
Flauto proposes a framework for reading the transfer. It is not enough to identify the receiving institution: the letter invites one to observe the ties built around the school complex and the support they provide to the students' educational path. The source focuses attention on four elements of the work carried out at IC Como Borgovico.
| Area | Element described in the letter | |---|---| | Curriculum | shared methodology and mission, coordinated across school levels | | Teachers | continuous professional development, inclusion and shared planning | | Network | music, sports, artistic and language projects | | Spaces | environments designed for creativity and inclusion, with PNRR resources |
The shared curriculum connects the institute's primary schools with its nursery schools and lower secondary school. According to the teacher, continuous training has unified the educational language, inclusion strategies and planning documents. The letter presents these elements as parts of the same pedagogical mission, not as isolated initiatives.
The musical, sports, artistic and linguistic synergies add daily collaboration among teachers from the different school levels. The learning environments, designed with PNRR resources, are described as serving creativity and inclusion, within the institute's overall vision. The practical point is the connection between people, tools and spaces.
### The criterion for evaluating the change
The consequence pointed out by the letter is therefore not simply a change of label. If the school complexes are treated as isolated and interchangeable entities, relationships, families' trust and the professional heritage accumulated by teachers are separated. According to Flauto, this weakens the very meaning of school planning and makes it more difficult to protect the stability of educational pathways.
The transition must be read within a complete network: primary, early childhood and secondary education, but also connections among teachers. The letter recalls the relationship with Raschi and Foscolo and describes the closure of Corridoni primary school, with the transfer of the school population to IC Como Centro Città, as a break in natural continuity.
